mapper.insert: insert into ${productsPriceNewTable} (primary_key, operate_Code, operate_Name, remark, formula, source_Table, source_Id, create_time, update_time, enterprise_code, manage_Cost, formula_En, copy_state) values (#{record.id}, #{record.personCode}, #{record.personName}, #{record.remark}, #{record.formula}, #{record.sourceTable}, #{record.sourceId}, now(), now(), #{enterpriseCode} , #{record.manageCost}, #{record.formulaEn}, #{record.copyState})
mapper.select:
select * from (select a.*, rank() over (partition by source_id,source_table order by create_Time desc ,id desc ) rs from ${dynamicTableNameProxy.productsPriceNew} a where (source_id, source_table) in
(#{i.sourceId},#{i.sourceTable})
and delete_flag = false and enterprise_code = ${dynamicTableNameProxy.enterpriseCode} ) where rs = 1
